authority.source: Link wallets you control to share their owned history in one private account. Funds, research limits, signing, API keys and creator powers stay with each wallet.
authority.text: 关联您控制的钱包，在同一个私密账户中共享各钱包拥有的历史记录。资金、研究限额、签名、API 密钥和创作者权限仍分别属于各钱包。

walletFree.source: New to wallets? The existing Google sign-in can create an unfunded, user-controlled Circle wallet. Account creation requires a separate confirmation here.
walletFree.text: 刚接触钱包？现有的 Google 登录方式可创建由用户控制、尚未注资的 Circle 钱包。创建账户需要在此另行确认。

consentSuffix.source: a private account and sharing my verified wallet's owned history.
consentSuffix.text: 私密账户，并共享我已验证钱包所拥有的历史记录。

unlinkConsent.source: I confirm removal of the selected wallet's account access. Its own history and financial obligations remain.
unlinkConsent.text: 我确认移除所选钱包的账户访问权限。该钱包自身的历史记录及财务义务将保留。

linkConsent.source: I explicitly share this wallet's past and future owned history. Its funds, signing, API keys, claims and creator powers stay separate.
linkConsent.text: 我明确同意共享此钱包过去和未来拥有的历史记录。其资金、签名、API 密钥、认领和创作者权限仍相互独立。

confirmIntent.source: Confirm the exact account, wallet and intent below. This proof expires after five minutes.
confirmIntent.text: 确认下方的确切账户、钱包和意图。此证明将在五分钟后过期。

targetSignatureHelp.source: Sign these exact message bytes with the target wallet using personal_sign, while keeping the initiating sign-in unchanged. A Circle wallet needs its independently verified signing context; changing this sign-in makes the link stale.
targetSignatureHelp.text: 使用目标钱包通过 personal_sign 签署这些确切的消息字节，同时保持发起此次操作的登录状态不变。Circle 钱包需要独立验证的签名上下文；更改此次登录会使关联失效。
